description: This file defines a Java interface 'JobParameterProvider' for providing job parameters in a job infrastructure context, likely related to batch processing with Spring Batch in the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: JobParameterProvider
classes.description: A Java interface for classes that provide job parameters for batch jobs. It has methods to supply parameters based on a set of DTOs and to check if parameters can be provided for a specific job.

methods.name: provide
methods.description: Returns a map of job parameters keyed by their names, for a given set of JobParameterDTO objects.

methods.name: canProvideParametersForJob
methods.description: Checks if this provider can supply parameters for the specified job name.
